summary: Iteration 5 — Microsoft Graph (OneDrive + Outlook) OAuth wiring + admin-only Documents-tab card. All 24 NEW backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_ms_graph.py PASS. Full regression suite (excluding the documented-as-pre-existing iter2 templates bitrot) is 59/59 PASS. Verified each /api/ms/* endpoint: GET /api/ms/status (admin) returns configured=true, connected=false after disconnect, schedule string 'Runs on the 1st of every month at 02:00 America/New_York'. GET /api/ms/auth-url returns a well-formed login.microsoftonline.com URL with tenant_id f8812a89… in the path, client_id 23be8faf… in query, redirect_uri ending /api/ms/callback, and scope containing offline_access + Files.ReadWrite + Mail.Send (MSAL automatically appends the reserved offline_access scope even when MS_SCOPES env doesn't include it). GET /api/ms/callback?error=access_denied returns a 400 HTML page (NOT 500) with a Cancelled message and an icon. POST /api/ms/email-recipients with comma-separated emails persists and is reflected by /api/ms/status.email_to. POST /api/ms/disconnect (admin) wipes the integration record and connected flips back to false. POST /api/ms/export-now without a stored refresh_token returns 400 with detail 'not_connected'. Caregiver token returns 403 on every /api/ms/* endpoint. Unauthenticated calls return 401/403. Regression: GET /api/reports/audit-binder still serves a valid PDF (starts with %PDF-, >1KB) and is still admin-only (caregiver 403) — the _build_audit_binder_bytes() helper refactor is sound. Other unrelated endpoints (login, documents, shifts, assignments, caregivers) all still 200. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport): admin login → Documents tab shows the green 'Connect Microsoft 365' CTA card with cloud-outline icon, title 'Connect Microsoft 365', subtitle 'Auto-export the Audit Binder to OneDrive on the 1st of every month.' and chevron-forward. testID='ms-connect' resolves. Caregiver login → Documents tab does NOT render ms-connect or ms-disconnect (card correctly gated by user?.role === 'admin' on documents.tsx:256). Caregiver still sees their own add-document-button. No React Native red screens, no deprecated Expo packages introduced (msal/httpx/apscheduler are backend-only Python deps). Console only emits 2 known harmless warnings (expo-notifications web-push not supported, props.pointerEvents deprecated by RN — neither introduced by this iteration).

minor.issue: There is no email-format / length validation on email_to. An admin can persist literally any string (e.g. 'not-an-email'). Consider validating with EmailStr-list parsing or at least re.split(',') + EmailStr per token before saving, otherwise the scheduled job may pass garbage to Outlook sendMail and fail at run time.

When MSAL token exchange fails for a real (non-cancelled) reason, the HTML page exposes result.get('error_description') verbatim — which can contain the raw Microsoft URL & client request id. Low severity (admin-only flow in practice) but worth scrubbing or logging-only.

/app/backend/.env MS_SCOPES='Files.ReadWrite Mail.Send User.Read' OMITS offline_access. Today MSAL Python's ConfidentialClientApplication implicitly adds offline_access as a reserved scope so a refresh_token is still issued (verified — auth URL contains offline_access). But this is undocumented MSAL behaviour; safer to add 'offline_access' explicitly to MS_SCOPES in .env so a future MSAL upgrade can't silently break monthly refresh.

Returns HTTPException(400, res.get('reason')) so the body is {detail: 'not_connected'}. FE alerts e?.message — that surfaces 'HTTP 400' rather than the friendly 'not_connected' string. Consider returning a JSON body the FE can read for a better UX message.

issues: With admin role, the header row already crams 4 buttons (Audit Binder, Share Packet, Templates, +). On 390-wide screens the Share Packet pill is partly clipped at the right edge (see admin_docs_card.png). Consider moving Audit Binder / Templates into an overflow menu, OR letting the row wrap. Not a regression — pre-existing layout.

action_items: (Optional, low) Add 'offline_access' explicitly to backend/.env MS_SCOPES so future MSAL releases can't break refresh-token issuance.
(Optional, low) Validate emails in POST /api/ms/email-recipients with a list of EmailStr before persisting.

(Optional, UX) POST /api/ms/export-now: return a JSON body that the MicrosoftIntegrationCard can render as a friendly error ('Connect Microsoft 365 before running an export'), instead of bare HTTPException(400, 'not_connected').
(Optional, layout) The admin Documents header has 4 buttons + ‘+’ — Share Packet / Templates labels are clipped at 390px. Consider an overflow menu.
critical_code_review_comments: Excellent OAuth surface: configured() guard returns 503 instead of crashing when MS_* env is missing; require_admin enforced on every /api/ms/* endpoint; redirect URI matches the public preview host so Microsoft will accept it; refresh_token is stored singleton in db.integrations and rotated on every refresh — solid.
_ms_run_monthly_export correctly degrades to {'ok': false, 'reason': 'not_connected'} or 'refresh_failed' rather than throwing — the cron job won't crash the scheduler.
OneDrive chunked upload uses upload sessions (createUploadSession + 5MB PUT chunks) so binders >4MB are supported. conflictBehavior:'replace' avoids monthly duplicates.

_build_audit_binder_bytes() helper refactor is clean: /api/reports/audit-binder still 200 with %PDF- bytes (regression test passes), and the same helper is reused by the scheduled job and POST /api/ms/export-now — DRY.

Scheduler started in @app.on_event('startup') with timezone=America/New_York, cron(day=1, hour=2, minute=0), coalesce=True, misfire_grace_time=3600 — survives short backend restarts and won't double-fire. Properly shut down in @app.on_event('shutdown').
server.py is now ~2250 lines — STRONGLY recommend splitting (e.g. routers/ms.py, routers/documents.py, routers/shifts.py). Flagged previously in iter3/iter4 — getting worse.

MicrosoftIntegrationCard.tsx: clean state machine (loading → not-configured warn / not-connected CTA / connected card). Uses Pressable + testID throughout (ms-connect, ms-disconnect, ms-export-now, ms-set-emails, ms-email-input, ms-save-emails). Polls /ms/status 5s after openURL so the card flips after OAuth tab returns.
documents.tsx correctly gates the card with `{user?.role === 'admin' && <MicrosoftIntegrationCard />}` on line 256 — verified at runtime.

Linking.addEventListener('url', …) in the card will only fire if the OAuth tab returns via a deep link. On web, window.open(_blank) doesn't deep-link back — relying on the setTimeout(load, 5000) re-poll is correct.
